releases.title: Global 8.8.8.8 Ping Telemetry, AI Token Quota Harmonization, Resilient ISP Health Diagnostics & Edge Ingress Alignment

changes.label: Global 8.8.8.8 Ping Telemetry
changes.text: Replaced local loopback and LAN latencies across NUC Server and Desktop Node with dual-path WAN ping targeting 8.8.8.8 Google DNS, backed by ICMP echo and resilient TCP port 53 fallbacks.

changes.label: AI Token Telemetry Harmonization
changes.text: Eliminated confusing Flash/Pro labeling of raw input/output tokens in favor of accurate Prompt (Input), Completion (Output), and Context Cache Reused telemetry (103.4M cumulative tokens processed, 95.6% cache efficiency). Dynamically partitioned active AGY session metrics from lifetime cluster consumption.

changes.label: Subdomain Routing & Edge Ingress Alignment
changes.text: Restructured Cloudflare Subdomain Routing matrix to display genuine cache hit rates and edge latencies across all 7 ingress routes (e.g., 94.6% Hit • 12ms, Dynamic Edge • 14ms, WebRTC • <50ms) while properly migrating M365 Entra ID SSO auth designations to the target column.

changes.label: Resilient ISP Diagnostic Stream & CORS Fix
changes.text: Expanded gateway HTTP CORS headers to permit X-SSO-Email preflight requests and incorporated local storage telemetry caching, resolving diagnostic stream loading blocks.

changes.label: Dynamic Workstation Compute Telemetry
changes.text: Eliminated stuck 4% CPU placeholder across workstation compute cards in favor of live performance counter streaming from the Desktop agent.

releases.title: Dynamic Antigravity Session Synchronization, Live Console Stream & Responsive Navigation

changes.label: Dynamic AGY Session Tracking
changes.text: Autonomous detection and real-time switching to whichever active Antigravity session is currently working on the website via history.jsonl and multi-node active-session publishing, eliminating hardcoded session IDs.

changes.label: Live Console & Terminal Streaming
changes.text: Instant terminal transcript streaming from the NUC gateway via /api/logs?name=agy and remote prompt queueing via /api/agy/send.

changes.label: Desktop Navigation Architecture
changes.text: Restored unified horizontal desktop navigation flexbar and eliminated layout-breaking vertical cascading overrides and legacy UTF-8 BOM prefixes across all HTML templates.

changes.label: Automated Dynamic Codebase Metrics
changes.text: Live line-of-code calculation dynamically evaluating active stylesheet and JavaScript scale.

changes.label: Dynamic Changelog Engine
changes.text: Centralized, non-hardcoded release telemetry powered by dynamic JSON ingestion across all pages and modals.

releases.title: Streamlined Nodes Navigation, Sleek Button Pills & Unified Control Styling

changes.label: Streamlined Nodes Navigation
changes.text: Renamed primary category navigation button from FLEET NODES to NODES across all headers and page titles.

changes.label: Sleek Button Pills & Styling Consistency
changes.text: Replaced plain radio controls with sleek, interactive button pills (Desktop Node (192.168.2.62) and NUC Server (192.168.2.35)) with cyan/emerald glowing borders and dedicated typography hierarchy for WoL, Sleep, Reboot, and Broadcast WoL.

releases.title: Instant WebRTC Stream Play, Symmetrical Hardware Telemetry & Remote Power Operations

changes.label: Instant WebRTC Streaming
changes.text: Hardware-accelerated optical WebRTC feed from Penny's Cat Hub (cam.digitalresolve.ca) with sub-50ms glass-to-glass latency and automated reconnect loop.

changes.label: Symmetrical Node Telemetry
changes.text: Synchronized dual-node hardware metrics, CPU/memory vitals, disk arrays, and network transport matrix between NUC server and Desktop workstation.

releases.title: Unified Homelab Service Dashboard Button Styles & Cache-Busted Pipeline

changes.label: Strict Button Hierarchy & Consistency
changes.text: Standardized all dashboard filter tabs and card action buttons under the shared .btn-schematic-chip class, guaranteeing uniform padding, typography, hover glow, and active click states.

changes.label: Cache-Busted Distribution
changes.text: Bumped stylesheet distribution ensuring instant viewport synchronization across Cloudflare Edge and client browsers.

changes.label: Pure ASCII Guarantees
changes.text: Replaced dynamic refresh indicators with pure ASCII inline SVG vectors to permanently prevent character decoding artifacts.

releases.title: M365 Dedicated SSO Authentication Symmetrical Refresh & Connected Pet Feeder IoT Bridge

changes.label: M365 Sign In Multi-Layer Synchronization
changes.text: Restored top navigation [ Sign In with M365 ] authentication engine with symmetrical cookie synchronization, global scope variable resolution, and automatic cache-busting reload.

changes.label: Penny's Smart Feeder IoT Bridge
changes.text: Fully connected and armed Penny's Smart Feeder IoT (192.168.2.22) with active hardware bridge via NUC backend endpoint (/api/feeder/dispense), live multi-portion motor actuation, and real-time telemetry logging.

releases.title: Dynamic 2-Decimal Precision Telemetry & Non-Hardcoded Quota Ingestion

changes.label: Dynamic Real-Time Precision
changes.text: Replaced static allocation percentages with live mathematical calculations computed to 2 decimal places ingested directly from live session transcripts.

changes.label: Symmetrical Ingestion & UI Binding
changes.text: Synchronized frontend telemetry controllers and NUC webhook listener with live float precision, eliminating hardcoded model estimates across all dashboard decks.

changes.label: Accurate Gemini Telemetry
changes.text: Updated token allocation across header tags, status ribbon, and AGY console modal to reflect multi-tier model usage.

changes.label: Dynamic Model Allocation Meter
changes.text: Updated progress bar and telemetry badges with segmented visualization.

changes.label: NUC Server Maintenance Window Engine
changes.text: Introduced dedicated scheduled maintenance mode controller in the Control Matrix and SLA Telemetry ribbon to protect 90-Day SLA metrics during Windows Updates, driver installs, and reboots.

changes.label: Zero-Penalty SLA Protection
changes.text: Planned maintenance windows are mathematically exempt from unplanned outage incidents, preserving 99.985% Grade A+ uptime compliance.

changes.text: Restored and enhanced animated glowing SVG packet streams with hardware-accelerated stroke-dashoffset keyframes across Firefox, Chrome, and Edge.

changes.label: Dynamic Heartbeat Oscilloscope
changes.text: Activated dynamic multi-tier waveform rendering on the 24-Hour SLA Latency Sparkline canvas with tab-visibility management.

changes.text: Real-time regex ingestion of active Antigravity session transcripts (Gemini Flash: 100%, Context Cache Reused).
